title: Generative Media Engineer, AI Social - CANADA
description_html:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

AI Social is one of the most ambitious products we've ever shipped. An AI agent that produces on-brand Instagram carousels and reels for every Luxury Presence customer, from raw input data to finished media. It isn't LLMs writing code. It's LLMs designing, choosing the photo, voicing the script, picking the cuts, and composing the final frame.

As the Generative Media Engineer on AI Social, you own the render pipeline, the prompts and agent loops that drive it, and the visual quality of what ships. Product and content strategy partners set the direction; engineering and design peers ship alongside you. This is an unusual role at the intersection of code, design, AI, and social media. You don't fit the normal engineering mold, that's the point.

Skills and experience

  • Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js. You're comfortable shipping production code and you're ready to grow into our stack.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-driven systems. Prompts, structured outputs, tool-calling, agent loops, evals.
  • At least one shipped piece of generative media in image, video, voice, or music that someone other than you has seen and used.
  • A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates both technical depth and design sensibility.
  • Bonus: a personal creator practice somewhere. A feed, a portfolio, a side project, a YouTube channel, an Are.na. Public, ongoing, under your own name. You understand the medium because you've lived in it.
  • Formal or self-taught grounding in design, visual art, film, or motion.
  • Comfort moving between exploratory PoC work and shipped-to-customers polish, with judgment about which mode is appropriate when.

Technical fluency with AI tools

  • You're already using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools in your daily workflow. We're a Claude Code shop and we expect you to be fluent.
  • Familiarity with MCPs and how tools like Figma, Notion, and Linear connect into AI-assisted workflows. You understand how these tools and integrations fit together and can help the team get more out of them.
  • Beyond fluency, you're a dabbler and experimenter. You try new prompts, push their limits, and share what you learn. You have opinions about where the medium is headed.

Mindset

  • You're a tinkerer. You don't just build what's asked; you spot leverage points and build what's needed.
  • You care about systems more than features. You'd rather build a template family that ships ten posts well than ten bespoke posts that age out by next week.
  • You build on shared systems. Constraints feel like leverage, not obstacles.
  • You have strong convictions about quality, but you ship. You know the difference between polish that matters and perfection that stalls.
  • You partner well with non-engineers. You'll collaborate across product, design, and content strategy. Patience and clarity with people outside engineering is non-negotiable.
  • You operate with high ownership and low ego. You take direction from product and strategy partners on what to build, and you raise the bar on everything you ship.

What You Won't Be Doing

To be clear about what this role is not:

  • You won't own platform architecture or distributed systems work. You'll partner with engineering teams that do, while you stay focused on the AI Social pipeline itself.
  • You won't own the social strategy. You'll have a real voice in shaping it, but the call sits with our product and content strategy partners.
  • You won't be managing people on day one. This is a hands-on IC role with the expectation that you lead through craft and influence.

Tech stack

  • Platform: Node, TypeScript, React, Postgres, AWS, Temporal
  • LLMs and agents: the major model SDKs, with tool-calling, structured outputs, and multi-step agent loops
  • Media pipeline: image and video generation (Veo for video), voice and music synthesis (ElevenLabs), composite (Shotstack), and headless browser rendering

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

title: Product Designer II
description_html:
Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com.
__________________________

Product Designer II

About The Role

Built Technologies is the AI-first platform for construction and real estate finance, trusted by Goldman Sachs, Fifth Third, and 45 of the top 100 U.S. banks to manage over $300 billion in annual capital. The design challenges at Built are genuinely complex: the lenders, owners, developers, and contractors using our platform are navigating high-stakes financial workflows where clarity, accuracy, and trust are not nice-to-haves — they are requirements. Making those workflows feel simple and human without sacrificing depth is the central design problem. The Product Designer II is a practitioner ready to own meaningful pieces of that problem independently.

This role is for a designer who has built a solid foundation and is ready to drive design decisions with greater autonomy. You independently own design work across features and product areas with growing complexity, lead research activities, and are actively developing your ability to scope problems and communicate design rationale to cross-functional partners.

Our Guiding Principles

  • Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don’t hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.
  • Help Customers Win. We learn our customers’ businesses deeply — how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.
  • Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds — and we build it every day.
  • Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don’t wait to be asked.
  • Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

What You’ll Do

  • Own design execution for features and workflows across Built’s platform — from discovery through delivery — including the draw management, budget tracking, and compliance surfaces that lenders and borrowers depend on.
  • Lead user research activities including customer interviews, usability tests, and synthesis sessions — becoming a genuine expert in how lenders, owners, contractors, and inspectors use Built.
  • Create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, and high-fidelity mockups with increasing complexity — choosing the right fidelity for the question at hand rather than defaulting to one approach.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to ensure designs are feasible, well-understood, and implemented with fidelity to intent.
  • Contribute to and maintain the design system, identifying opportunities to improve shared components and patterns across the product portfolio.
  • Clearly articulate design decisions and trade-offs to cross-functional stakeholders — framing rationale in terms of user needs and business outcomes, not just aesthetics. • Incorporate data and behavioral insights to validate and iterate on design solutions — using evidence to challenge your own assumptions.
  • Support more junior designers through informal feedback and collaboration, sharing your process and approach openly.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2–4+ years of experience in product or UX design within a SaaS or digital product environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools — you work efficiently at multiple fidelity levels and prototype thoughtfully to answer specific questions.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle end-to-end design for product features independently — from research and problem framing through execution and QA.
  • Solid understanding of UX research methods and when to apply them — you know the difference between generative and evaluative research and can lead both. • A portfolio showing thoughtful problem-framing and well-executed design solutions — work that reflects how you think, not just the final output.
  • A clear and confident communicator who can present work, defend decisions, and incorporate feedback without becoming defensive.
  • Attention to accessibility and inclusive design best practices is a meaningful plus.

What Success Looks Like at Six Months

  • You are independently owning design for at least one feature area — from research through shipped experience — and the quality of what ships reflects your design intent. • Product managers and engineers treat you as a reliable, proactive design partner who contributes perspective beyond just executing to spec.
  • You have led at least one user research session with real customers and used the findings to inform or adjust a design direction.
  • Your design system contributions are accurate, well-considered, and improve consistency across the product.
  • You are developing genuine depth in construction finance domain knowledge — you understand Built’s customer segments and can explain how design decisions affect their real work.

AI & Technology Expectations

  • Leverage AI tools to enhance the productivity, quality, and speed of your work.
  • Use AI to support drafting, analysis, summarization, and problem-solving across your role.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort through automation and AI.
  • Apply AI to sharpen decision-making and strengthen strategic insights. • Share effective AI use cases and best practices with your team.

Built’s salary range for this position is $100,000 - 125,000 USD per year. The pay range is designed to accommodate upward mobility in the role, therefore it encompasses the full span of proficiency levels for this role and we believe that the midpoint of the range is competitive in the market. Salary is just one component of Built's total compensation package for employees; your total rewards package at Built will include equity, market-current medical, dental and vision coverage, an unlimited PTO policy, and other benefits.

__________________________

Travel Requirement: Employees who are not based in the Nashville area are required to travel to our Nashville office at least twice per year for company gatherings, such as Connect Week. Additional travel to Nashville may be required based on your role and business needs.

Perks:

  • The rare opportunity to radically disrupt a $1.5T industry
  • Competitive benefits including: uncapped vacation [US ONLY], medical, dental & vision insurance
  • Robust compensation package, including equity in the form of stock options
  • Learning Grant program to support ongoing professional development
  • 401k with match and expedited vesting [US ONLY]

Built brings together passionate people who are driven in a variety of disciplines, each bringing their unique perspective to everything they do. We’re committed to building a safe, inclusive workplace where every employee can succeed, and we recruit, hire, and promote fairly - without bias based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Built is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process, please share with your Talent Partner or email careers@getbuilt.com.

Greenhouse Data Disclosure: When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Built. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Built’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, communicating with you regarding your application (including via text message),and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Built to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Built’s behalf. Your personal data will also be shared with Grayscale Labs, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Built Technologies to facilitate candidate communications, including text messaging.Your personal data will be retained by Built as long as Built determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for current or future employment. You have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability.

Built Privacy Policy

By providing your phone number, you consent to receive text messages from Built related to your application. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out at any time by replying STOP.

If you would like to contact Built to ask questions surrounding processing of your personal data or to make a request, you can send an email to privacy@getbuilt.com. California residents: Please note that Built does not sell your personal data. For details on how your data is shared with our service providers, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Staff Social Strategy & Operations Manager
description_html:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

Summary: You'll own ClickUp's social strategy and build the systems to execute it at scale. You deeply understand what wins on each platform: the formats, the hooks, the timing, the tone. But you're not just a strategist who hands off a plan. You build AI-powered workflows and automation to operationalize your strategy so it runs continuously, learns from data, and scales beyond what any team could do manually. You're a social-native operator who builds systems, not an engineer who dabbles in social.

Responsibilities:

  • Own platform-native social strategy across X, LinkedIn, TikTok, and emerging channels: define what ClickUp's voice, format, and engagement approach looks like on each, tailored to what works on that platform

  • Develop and execute content and engagement strategies that drive measurable growth in reach, engagement, and audience quality

  • Identify trends, conversations, and cultural moments worth engaging with, and move fast enough to capitalize on them

  • Build AI-powered systems and automated workflows to execute social strategy at scale: monitoring, engagement, response, and content distribution

  • Create feedback loops between social performance data and strategy; use signal to iterate what gets made and how it gets distributed

  • Own proactive engagement: identify and engage relevant conversations, mentions, and opportunities using AI-powered monitoring and automated response workflows

  • Develop automated systems that handle routine engagement while escalating high-value or brand-sensitive conversations to humans

  • Own execution end-to-end: strategy through measurement, with clear accountability for outcomes

  • Partner with content creators, influencer team, and brand to ensure systems amplify their work

  • Establish and report on social growth KPIs with clear attribution

Requirements:

  • 5-7+ years in social media strategy with demonstrated expertise in platform-native content and engagement strategy (you know what works on X vs. LinkedIn vs. TikTok and why)

  • Proven track record of growing social presence with strategic intent: not just posting more, but understanding the mechanics of each platform and exploiting them

  • Strong creative taste and editorial instinct for what resonates on social: you can look at a piece of content and know whether it'll hit before it goes live

  • 2+ years building AI-powered systems and automated workflows to scale social execution (monitoring, engagement, response, distribution). Using ChatGPT to draft captions is not sufficient.

  • Technical fluency: comfortable with APIs, automation platforms (Zapier, Make, custom), and can deploy integrations between systems without an engineer

  • Strong strategic thinker who takes things from 0 to 1 independently: vision to execution, measurable outcomes, zero hand-holding

  • Data-obsessed: builds dashboards, runs experiments, iterates based on signal not gut

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Privacy Notice

ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

Fraud Alert

ClickUp Talent Acquisition will only initiate contact via an @clickup.com email or through our official careers portal on clickup.com. We will never request fees, payments, or sensitive personal information. Please disregard any offers received outside these channels and report them to support@clickup.com.

AI Processing Notice

ClickUp may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to help review and screen candidates' employment applications against role-related criteria. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision‑making. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer - US
description_html:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to build and scale the analytical foundation that powers decision-making across Go-to-Market, Product, Finance, People, and Operations teams.

You will sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics: transforming raw product, marketing, financial, and operational data into clean, well-modeled, and trustworthy datasets. Your work will power everything from executive dashboards and cohort analyses to experimentation, billing operations, AI-powered outreach, and semantic layers that let AI agents answer stakeholder questions autonomously.

This is a highly cross-functional role — you'll partner closely with Product Management, Marketing, RevOps, Finance, People Ops, and Engineering to ensure our analytics stack is robust, scalable, and aligned with the business.

Responsibilities

Build & Own the Data Foundation

  • Own and evolve our dbt project — ensuring models are performant, well-tested, and documented.

  • Design and maintain the Snowflake data warehouse and ingestion processes.

  • Use modern data modeling best practices to create core entities and datasets that account for complex business processes and logic.

  • Build and maintain custom Python/Airflow pipelines to ingest data from third-party APIs into Snowflake.

  • Design and operate cross-system reconciliation models that compare data across source systems to surface discrepancies and protect revenue.

Drive Data Quality & Automation

  • Implement testing and observability for analytics pipelines.

  • Enforce CI/CD best practices, such as automation, linting, tests, code review and approvals.

  • Standardize metric definitions and ensure they are consistently computed across tools.

  • Investigate and document data incidents end-to-end — from root cause analysis through remediation tracking and stakeholder communication.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as data liaison between Engineering, GTM, and Finance — ensuring consistent metric definitions and proper system instrumentation.

  • Enable stakeholder self-service access to trusted insights.

  • Drive data literacy: evangelize best practices in querying, dashboarding, and interpreting metrics; coach stakeholders toward self-serve.

Build AI-Ready Data Infrastructure

  • Design and maintain Snowflake Cortex semantic views that serve as the governed data interface for AI agents and LLM-powered tools.

  • Partner with AI/product teams to scope, build, and validate the semantic layer definitions that power internal AI assistants.

  • Build measurement frameworks for AI-powered initiatives — including experiment design and attribution modeling.

Qualifications

Must Have:

  • 5+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or a similar role in a SaaS environment.

  • Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, and modern data modeling best practices.

  • Proficiency in Python for pipeline development, API integrations, and automation.

  • Experience modeling Salesforce data — opportunities, contracts, subscriptions, cases, and field history.

  • Proven experience building custom ELT pipelines that ingest data from third-party APIs into a cloud data warehouse.

  • Experience designing cross-system reconciliation models — joining, deduplicating, and comparing data across multiple source systems to surface discrepancies.

  • Proven experience working with event-based and product usage data (e.g., Posthog, Mixpanel).

  • Experience connecting marketing data (paid ads, campaigns, attribution) to product analytics — ideally having built end-to-end pipelines from ad platforms through to conversion and retention metrics.

  • Experience designing and maintaining semantic layers that serve as governed data interfaces (dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake Cortex, or similar).

  • Comfortable with large-scale data systems (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

  • Strong familiarity with CI/CD, Git-based workflows, and automated testing.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with engineers, analysts, and product managers.

  • Demonstrated success using analytics to drive decisions in a technical or product-focused environment.

  • Comfort taking ownership of ambiguous problems and designing end-to-end solutions.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience building and maintaining Airflow DAGs and orchestrating multi-source API ingestion pipelines.

  • Strong foundation in statistics and experiment design — A/B testing, significance testing, and measuring incremental impact.

  • Experience with predictive modeling fundamentals — classification, feature selection, and model evaluation.

  • Familiarity with financial SaaS metrics and billing operations (ARR/MRR/NRR, subscription reconciliation, revenue recognition).

  • Experience with people analytics (headcount, attrition, compensation benchmarking).

What Success Looks Like

  • Establish a trusted, well-modeled analytics layer that product managers, marketers, and leaders rely on daily.

  • Improve data quality and reliability, with clear SLAs and observability around our most critical models.

  • Drive down time-to-insight by enabling self-serve access to high-quality datasets and metrics.

  • Extreme ownership over critical infrastructure and data models that directly impact product decisions and business growth.

  • Partner with data engineers and analysts to build a semantic layer that AI agents can use to answer stakeholder questions — and actively maintain the semantic views that power those agents.

  • Proactively identify and quantify data discrepancies across systems and drive them to resolution with operational teams.

  • Design measurement frameworks for new initiatives — defining what to track, how to measure impact, and what "success" means before launch.

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Security
description_html:
About the Team

OpenAI builds powerful AI systems like ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, and enterprise products that serve millions of users across the globe. As we scale, securing our infrastructure, protecting sensitive data, and meeting global compliance standards are essential to our success and societal impact.

Security at OpenAI is a cross-cutting function that spans infrastructure, applied engineering, legal, policy, and product. Technical Program Managers (TPMs) play a critical leadership role in aligning teams and delivering execution at scale and this role will be foundational in shaping how we secure OpenAI’s systems, users, and commitments.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive cross-functional security, privacy, IT and compliance initiatives at the intersection of infrastructure, product, and policy. You will execute complex programs that reduce internal data access, prevent misuse, and ship security capabilities. You will focus your efforts on the most critical initiatives within Security, crossing the spectrum of insider threat, information security, physical security, and information technology challenges.

This role is deeply technical and execution-focused. It requires a structured operator who thrives in ambiguity, partners effectively across boundaries, and applies principled judgment to scale trust, governance, and security across OpenAI’s systems and products.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive execution of critical security and compliance programs such as vulnerability management, merger and acquisition security and integration, infrastructure hardening, and datacenter security management. You will need to deeply collaborate on technical architecture and resolve technical problems in partnership with engineering.

  • Partner with IT, Infrastructure, Application, Legal, Privacy, and Security teams to build scalable programs, and deliver critical security outcomes across multiple disciplines, including insider threat, information security, physical security, and information technology.

  • Establish scalable frameworks and build programs around critical security initiatives including vulnerability management, evidence collection, incident response coordination, supply chain risk management, and device security.

  • Track and enforce OpenAI’s privacy and security requirements by translating commitments into engineering milestones and driving their full implementation across systems.

  • Create and maintain program-level visibility across risk areas, security milestones, and cross-org dependencies—ensuring outcomes are delivered reliably and at high quality.

  • Communicate status, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly to technical and executive audiences and drive cross-functional execution with urgency and care.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are an empathetic communicator and leader—able to influence across technical and non-technical audiences, and build durable trust with partners.

  • Have 5+ years of experience leading complex technical programs focused on infrastructure security, data privacy, compliance, or enterprise platform capabilities.

  • Are deeply fluent in the intersection of engineering systems, security controls, and regulatory expectations—and are able to bring clarity and structure across all three.

  • Thrive in high-trust environments, bring rigor and systems thinking to ambiguity, and operate with a bias for aligned execution over org boundaries.

  • Are structured, detail-oriented, and rigorous in ensuring quality, accountability, and durable delivery.

  • Have a proven record of success driving highly cross-functional efforts across engineering, infrastructure, legal, compliance, and product stakeholders.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

title: Marketing Specialist (Fixed Contract / CDD)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Quantis
description_html:
Support our people. Amplify our impact.  

  • Do you want to contribute your Marketing expertise to a mission that truly matters?  
  • Do you want to develop your professional skills through real-world responsibilities and cross-team collaboration?  
  • Are you excited to work alongside sustainability experts and support them in delivering meaningful client impact?  
  • Are you ready to join an international, purpose-driven team where curiosity, growth, and teamwork thrive?  

 

THE ROLE 

As the branch Marketing Specialist, you will drive marketing strategy and execution for the France market while co-owning global strategy for the Cosmetics & Personal Care and Pharma sectors. This role is both a local strategist and a global sector contributor — connecting local business goals with global brand direction and ensuring each sector's priorities are activated effectively in-market. 

You will report to Managing Director France and partner with the Global Marketing Lead, Global Sector Leads, branch marketing peers and the global marketing team.  

This is a 13-month fixed-term position covering a maternity leave, with structured onboarding at the start and a clean handover at the end. 

 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE QUANTIS 

Quantis, a BCG company, is a leading sustainability consultancy helping organizations address complex environmental challenges. For two decades, our expert team has partnered with organizations across the globe to bring sustainability into strategy, decision making, and action. We guide companies from ambition to action by uniting the latest science with strategic insights, helping them navigate complexity, make progress on sustainability priorities and create lasting value. 

United by a shared commitment to making meaningful progress, our 250+ professionals embody a unique, collaborative culture that we call the Quantis Spirit. We are innovative. We are impact-oriented. We are science-driven. We are Quantis.  

Learn more about Quantis and our mission.   

 

ARE YOU READY TO SHAPE OUR PEOPLE EXPERIENCE AND DRIVE IMPACT?  

  • You are a purpose-driven marketing professional eager to put your skills to work towards our mission of bridging sustainability and business value. 
  • You bring 4+ years’ B2B marketing experience in professional services or consulting, ideally in global contexts. 
  • You have proven experience in building visibility, creating engagement, and measuring impact. 
  • You are comfortable balancing strategy with execution, from research and analysis to event management and content creation. 
  • You thrive in a collaborative, international team environment and can work independently to deliver results. 
  • You know how to create engagement with peers and stakeholders, both internally and externally. 
  • You’re a team player who works efficiently, independently, and follows through on deadlines. 
  • You have excellent written and spoken communication in French and English. 

 

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Local Marketing Strategy & Execution — France 

  • Develop and execute the France marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with both local business objectives and global brand direction. 
  • Serve as the marketing partner to local leadership, helping achieve sales and client-growth goals. 
  • Activate both global and local marketing — implementing global campaigns and content, and adapting them for French audiences. 
  • Create market-specific webinars and localized content to engage clients and prospects. 
  • Manage local PR and media relationships. 

Events 

  • Lead the France event strategy and execution — executing pre-defined and new opportunities, managing logistics, and ensuring brand consistency. 

Global Sector Ownership — Cosmetics & Personal Care and Pharma 

Wearing a dual hat as sector marketing point person for both sectors: 

  • Partner with the Global Sector Lead to execute pre-defined global sector strategy and adding new activations as prioritized. 
  • Ensure all other sector strategies are activated effectively in the French market. 
  • Share sector strategy with the global marketing team for consolidation into the global plan. 
  • Coordinate execution with branch peers and global marketing when sector activities take place outside France. 

Insight & Collaboration 

  • Provide feedback and insight to global teams on local performance, opportunities, and client needs. 

 

SOME OTHER DETAILS TO CONSIDER 

  • Contract: Fixed term (CDD), 13 months, maternity cover 
  • Location: Paris 
  • Optimal start date: December 2026 
  • Punctual collaboration with other Quantis branches (Switzerland, Italy, Germany, US) via web-conference 

 

Unlocking the Potential of All Quantisians 

At Quantis, Unlocking Potential means empowering our employees to thrive, enabling them to drive our mission and manifesto forward—creating meaningful impact for people and the planet. 

We aim to achieve this by nurturing a culture rooted in collective action, and shared purpose, where diversity is cherished, inclusion is lived, mental wellbeing is supported, and opportunities are open to all.

title: Electronics Process Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Secheron S Dot A
description_html:
Sécheron Hasler Group continues the Swiss tradition of over 140 years in the field of railway technology. We are a leading global supplier of electrical and electronic safety components and solutions and traction power systems for the railway industry and also provide solutions for renewable energy, DC grid, and other industrial systems. The name Sécheron Hasler Group is worldwide synonymous with Swiss Quality and represents a leading reference for state-of-the-art products supplied to the market.

With more than 1400 employees worldwide, we are wherever our customers are around the globe. We supply products approved in our customers’ countries or markets and deliver top-notch supply chain and customer services locally. We are looking for a skilled Industrial Coordination Manager to join our team. The role is based in France, with a French employment contract and local employment conditions.

Main Tasks

  • Participate in the design phase to understand and integrate constraints.
  • Define and validate manufacturing processes (assembly, testing, quality control).
  • Maintain manufacturing documentation UpToDate (BOMs, routings, procedures).
  • Coordinate interactions between R&D, production, quality and procurement teams.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues during production.
  • Participate in monitoring EMS manufacturing performance in terms of production capacity, quality, cost and delivery.
  • Define and coordinate implementation of assembly and testing phases for the final product in our Prague production unit.
  • Manage and monitor orders between Prague and the EMS manufacturing plant based on annual sales forecasts.
  • Lead prototyping, pre-series and ramp-up phases of the new product.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a design office or electronic product manufacturing environment.
  • Degree in Electronics Engineering.
  • Previous experience as an Industrialization / Methods Engineer and/or Industrial Transfer Manager.
  • Experience managing technical projects, including planning, coordination, and reporting.
  • Ability to produce clear, structured, and comprehensive technical documentation.
  • Strong knowledge of electronics, including electronic schematics, components, and industry standards (CE, RoHS, IPC, etc.).
  • Good understanding of industrial processes, including PCB assembly, testing, quality control, and traceability.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, including BOMs, mechanical drawings, and manufacturing files.
  • Experience working with CAD tools such as Altium, Eagle, SolidWorks, or similar.
  • Basic knowledge of automation and testing, including test benches, microcontroller programming, and validation scripts.
  • Fluent in both French and English.

Benefits

We have flat hierarchies and encourage direct communication between departments and levels of management. This enables us to make decisions quickly.

We give our employees total responsibility for their job tasks. All employees are encouraged to take initiative and contribute to the company’s operational excellence and have ample opportunities to achieve their personal and career growth objectives.

Your success in our global company will be supported by an ambitious international team and excellent working conditions.

title: Customer Growth Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Dataguard
description_html:
YOUR JOB

Are you excited by the idea of growing existing customers instead of chasing cold prospects? Do you thrive when commercial ownership, strategic account development and closing responsibility come together? As one of the first Account Managers at DataGuard, you'll take ownership of a portfolio of customers with significant untapped growth potential and help build our Account Management function from the ground up. If you enjoy uncovering new opportunities, expanding customer relationships and turning business challenges into commercial success, we'd love to hear from you.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • You take ownership of expansion revenue across a portfolio of existing customers that has been intentionally selected for its significant growth potential

  • You help build DataGuard's Account Management function from the ground up, shaping processes, collaboration models and best practices along the way

  • You create and execute strategic account plans that uncover new use cases, engage additional stakeholders and unlock growth opportunities across your accounts

  • You turn customer needs, regulatory changes and compliance & security requirements into commercially meaningful conversations and expansion opportunities

  • You work closely with Customer Success and Professional Services, leveraging their customer insights to identify and convert opportunities into revenue

  • You build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and lead commercial discussions from discovery through to negotiation and close

  • You drive long term account growth while helping more customers benefit from the full breadth of DataGuard's Security and Compliance solutions

  • You collaborate closely with the wider Sales team and report directly to the Head of Sales, playing a key role in DataGuard's growth journey

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world.

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs.

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market.

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget.

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You have experience owning revenue targets across a portfolio of existing customers, named accounts or a book of business in a B2B SaaS Environment

  • You know how to spot opportunity where others see a satisfied customer

  • You consistently uncover and convert growth opportunities into revenue through upsell, cross sell and strategic account development

  • You know how to navigate multiple stakeholders and build business cases that lead to commercial outcomes

  • You thrive in environments where not everything is fully built yet and see ambiguity as an opportunity rather than a blocker

  • You are fluent in German and English

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

#LI-DNI

title: Technician (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Black Semiconductor GmbH
description_html:
The Role

Black Semiconductor is seeking a hands-on and flexible Equipment & Process Development Technician to support the installation, qualification, operation, maintenance, process development, and ramp-up of our FabONE semiconductor manufacturing facility.

You will work across CMP, wet cleaning, plating, and Graphene processes and equipment, supporting both R&D and manufacturing activities.

This is a flexible, multi-functional role where responsibilities will adapt to business priorities and FabONE needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support equipment installation, commissioning, qualification, startup, operation, and maintenance.

  • Perform preventive/corrective maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and equipment recovery.

  • Act as a first responder for equipment alarms, abnormal conditions, and OOC events.

  • Monitor tool health, equipment performance, and process conditions to maintain high uptime and reliability.

  • Support CMP, wet cleaning, plating, Graphene and Chemical supply systems.

  • Manage critical consumables such as CMP pads, diamond disks, filters, PVA brushes, plating consumables, and chemicals.

  • Support process development, engineering experiments, process qualification, characterization, and optimization.

  • Support Graphene transfer, wet processing, patterning, equipment operation, and process development.

  • Assist Process and Equipment Engineers with tool tuning, recipe optimization, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

  • Collect and document equipment/process data and maintain accurate maintenance, qualification, and process records.

  • Support development and improvement of SOPs, PM procedures, and equipment standards.

  • Follow all cleanroom, chemical handling, EHS, and contamination-control requirements.

  • Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, EHS, R&D, and equipment suppliers.

  • Support other technical activities as required based on business and FabONE priorities.

Your Qualifications

  • Technical degree, apprenticeship, technician certification, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3-5+ years of semiconductor equipment, process, manufacturing, or technician experience.

  • Hands-on experience in one or more areas: CMP, wet cleaning, plating, wafer processing, equipment engineering, process development, or chemical systems.

  • Strong hands-on troubleshooting and maintenance experience.

  • Basic knowledge of pumps, valves, filters, tubing, sensors, motors, vacuum, chemical/fluid delivery, and equipment controls.

  • Experience with process development, equipment qualification, calibration, or optimization is a plus.

  • Graphene or advanced materials processing experience is a plus.

  • Ability to learn and support multiple equipment platforms and technologies.

  • Strong problem-solving, teamwork, communication, and documentation skills.

  • English proficiency required; German is a plus.

  • Willingness to work hands-on in a cleanroom and support a fast-paced startup/new-fab environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Safe, reliable, and available equipment.

  • Fast and effective response to equipment and process issues.

  • Stable and qualified CMP, Cleaning, Plating, and Graphene processes.

  • Strong support for R&D, engineering, and manufacturing activities.

  • Continuous improvement in uptime, reliability, process stability, quality, and efficiency.

  • Flexibility to support changing FabONE and business priorities.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect

If your application results in an employment relationship, your Applicant Data will be transferred to our personnel records and processed in accordance with applicable legal requirements; otherwise, your Applicant Data will be retained for up to six (6) months after completion of the recruitment process. Read more about our privacy policy here.

title: Working Student - Logistics (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Instagrid
description_html:
At Instagrid, you are part of the clean-tech revolution by bringing pure energy into your region, helping professional workers transitioning away from combustion generators and making it possible for them to experience a safe, efficient, clean and silent energy solution.

Your Mission

Instagrid ships hardware — globally, at volume, to customers who expect their orders to arrive on time and on spec. As a Working Student in Logistics, you keep that promise. You are the operational backbone of our internal shipping area: handling incoming and outgoing goods, managing documentation, coordinating carriers, and serving as the link between physical goods movement and the Sales and Customer Management teams who need accurate, real-time information to do their jobs.

This is an on-site role in Ludwigsburg. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Operations team — expect to spend real time on the warehouse floor, not behind a screen.

Your Impact

  • Incoming goods: Receive and verify deliveries against purchase orders, create item receipts in NetSuite, and flag discrepancies without delay

  • Outgoing goods: Pick, pack, and dispatch finished goods and spare parts accurately and on time, in line with customer orders and internal shipping requests

  • Carrier management: Select the right carrier and service level for each shipment, book collections, and keep carrier accounts and documentation up to date

  • Order fulfilment: Coordinate daily with our external warehouse partner to ensure all market demands are serviced without gaps

  • Returns processing: Unpack, inspect, and document customer returns; hand over items to quality or repair workflows with full traceability

  • Shipping documentation: Produce commercial invoices, packing lists, and delivery notes accurately and in a timely manner

  • Tracking and visibility: Keep Sales and Customer Management proactively informed on shipment status, resolve carrier exceptions early, and escalate delays before they reach the customer

  • Warehouse housekeeping: Maintain clean, labelled, and accurately stocked storage locations in line with our ERP records


  • Currently enrolled in logistics, supply chain management, business administration, or a related degree program

  • Reliable and committed to showing up — this is a fixed on-site role that requires consistent coordination around your university timetable

  • Precise and structured in everything you do: in logistics, a documentation error is not a minor mistake — it has consequences, and you know that

  • A proactive communicator who raises issues and shares updates without needing to be prompted

  • Confident using digital tools: ERP systems, carrier portals, and spreadsheets are part of your daily workflow

  • Fluent in German and English — both are essential for working with carriers, partners, and customers

Your Benefits

  • Real responsibility from day one — not busywork, but genuine ownership of live shipping operations

  • End-to-end exposure: from goods receipt and carrier selection through order fulfilment to returns and customer visibility

  • A lean, hands-on team that gives direct feedback and expects you to speak up when something isn't right

  • An inside view of what it takes to scale a hardware company — across operations, supply chain, and beyond

  • Flexible working hours coordinated around your university schedule

  • Generous holiday entitlement plus additional special leave days, on a pro-rata basis

This is Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.

At Instagrid, we are deeply committed to equal employment opportunities as we believe in the power of diverse teams. We do not just accept diversity but actively search for the best talent regardless of gender, ethnic origin, age, religion, sexual orientation or place of origin. Working as a team, we treat each other with respect and value each other’s opinions to achieve our common goals.

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

und einem möglichen Eintrittstermin!

Sie möchten Menschen dabei unterstützen, ihre Kompetenzen zu erkennen, berufliche Möglichkeiten zu erschließen und sich auf eine Weiterbildung oder Umschulung vorzubereiten? Für unser neu startendes Projekt „Talentcheck“ suchen wir eine engagierte pädagogische Fachkraft, die Lern- und Gruppenprozesse professionell gestaltet und unterschiedliche Voraussetzungen der Teilnehmenden in passgenaue Bildungsangebote übersetzt.

 

Ihre Aufgaben:

Sie planen und gestalten die pädagogischen Gruppen- und Lernangebote des Projekts. Dabei fördern Sie persönliche, soziale, methodische sowie digitale Kompetenzen und unterstützen die Teilnehmenden bei Potenzialanalyse, beruflicher Orientierung und Aktivierung.

 

Dazu gehört insbesondere:

  • Planung, Vorbereitung und Durchführung zielgruppengerechter Gruppenangebote und Lerneinheiten

  • Mitwirkung an Potenzialanalysen durch Beobachtungen, handlungsorientierte Übungen, Simulationen und berufsbezogene Arbeitsproben

  • Vermittlung von Informationen zu Berufsbildern, Arbeitsmarkt, Qualifizierungswegen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • Förderung persönlicher Kompetenzen wie Motivation, Leistungsfähigkeit, Selbstbild und realistische Selbsteinschätzung

  • Förderung sozialer und methodischer Kompetenzen wie Kommunikation, Teamfähigkeit, Konfliktfähigkeit, Problemlösung und Arbeitsorganisation

  • Stärkung interkultureller Kompetenzen sowie der IT- und Medienkompetenz

  • Anleitung bei Eigenrecherche, selbstständiger Aufgabenbearbeitung und Nutzung digitaler Lern- und Jobcenter-Angebote

  • individuelle Lernunterstützung und bedarfsgerechte Differenzierung innerhalb heterogener Gruppen

  • Dokumentation von Lernfortschritten und enge Abstimmung mit Jobcoaches und sozialpädagogischen Fachkräften

 

Sie schaffen eine wertschätzende und aktivierende Lernatmosphäre und verbinden pädagogische Struktur mit einem klaren Bezug zur beruflichen Praxis.


Ihr Profil:

  • Sie verfügen über einen anerkannten Berufs- oder Studienabschluss und mindestens einjährige Erfahrung in der beruflichen Eingliederung der Zielgruppe.

  • Sie können digitale Medien und Lehr-Lern-Konzepte sicher einsetzen und Inhalte zielgruppengerecht aufbereiten.

  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert, motivierend, teamorientiert und sind flexibel gegenüber projektübergreifenden Einsätzen.

 

Wir bieten

  • Eine sinnstiftende Aufgabe mit direktem Einfluss auf die Zukunft unserer Teilnehmenden und einen gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert,

  • Ein engagiertes Team mit flachen Kommunikationswegen und fachlichem Austausch,

  • eine strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten,

  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Firmenticket-Zuschuss, Gesundheitsangebote, betriebliche Krankenversicherung und Corporate Benefits.

  • Wir zahlen den pädagogischen Mindestlohn.

title: Business Data Analyst Finance & Requirements Management (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aer Group
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben:

Du verstehst Geschäftsprozesse, denkst analytisch und kannst komplexe Anforderungen verständlich strukturieren? Du bewegst Dich sicher zwischen Fachbereichen und technischen Teams und hast Freude daran, aus Daten und Anforderungen tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln? Dann suchen wir genau Dich als Business Data Analyst Finance & Requirements Management (m/w/d) in Teilzeit mit 30 Stunden pro Woche. In dieser Rolle bildest Du die Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Finance und technischen Teams und sorgst dafür, dass fachliche Anforderungen in erfolgreiche datenbasierte Lösungen übersetzt werden.

 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entgegennehmen, Strukturieren und fachliches Bewerten von Anforderungen aus Business, Finance, Controlling und angrenzenden Fachbereichen
  • Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen, Datenflüssen und fachlichen Use Cases mit Fokus auf buchhaltungsrelevante Vorgänge, Leistungsabrechnungen, Provisionsweitergaben und daraus resultierende Reporting-Anforderungen
  • Prüfung von Daten auf fachliche Plausibilität, Vollständigkeit, Konsistenz und Eignung für den jeweiligen Anwendungsfall
  • Erarbeitung und Dokumentation fachlicher Anforderungen sowie deren Übersetzung in umsetzbare technische Anforderungen
  • Erstellung von Fachkonzepten, Spezifikationen, Datenlogiken, Mapping-Dokumentationen, Akzeptanzkriterien und Testfällen
  • Abstimmung von Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Lösungsansätzen zwischen Fachbereichen und technischen Teams
  • Unterstützung bei der Qualitätssicherung sowie fachliche Validierung von umgesetzten Lösungen und Reports
  • Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen, Anforderungen und Datenstrukturen


Dein Profil:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Finance/Controlling, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Datenanalyse oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse kaufmännischer, finanzieller oder abrechnungsbezogener Daten
  • Erfahrung im Bereich Business Analysis, Requirements Engineering oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Business- und Finanzprozessen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Abrechnung, Reporting, Provisionen, Controlling oder Finanzwesen
  • Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen strukturiert aufzunehmen, kritisch zu hinterfragen, zu priorisieren und in klare Umsetzungsanforderungen zu überführen
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Datenstrukturen, Datenqualität und fachliche Datenmodellierung
  • Erfahrungen mit BI- und Reporting-Lösungen sowie Kenntnisse in SQL, Python oder vergleichbaren Skript- bzw. Programmiersprachen sind von Vorteil
  • Kommunikationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zusammenzubringen
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

 


Warum wir:

  • Work-Life-Balance ist uns wichtig. Wir bieten deshalb eine flexible Home-Office-Regelung in individueller Absprache mit deinem Team Lead. Bis zu 30 Tage Workation pro Jahr sind bei uns ebenfalls möglich.
  • Bei uns gibt es nicht nur den üblichen Obstkorb sondern von Montag bis Freitag ein kostenloses, frisch gekochtes Mittagessen (Bio und regional) in unserer eigenen Kantine am Standort Berlin. Alle Kollegen an den anderen Standorten bekommen alternativ Pluxee Gutscheine.
  • Wir arbeiten in einem zentral gelegenem Loft-Office in Berlin Kreuzberg mit viel Platz zum gemeinsamen Austausch und Netzwerken.
  • Wir zahlen Dir monatlich einen ÖPNV-Zuschuss von 50 Euro.
  • Wir bieten einen Zuschuss zur Altersvorsorge.
  • Dein Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen: Bei uns kommt wöchentlich ein Masseur (Massagen inkl. Zuschuss vom Arbeitgeber) und wir veranstalten viele gemeinsame Team- und Firmenevents, vom Bowling übers Sommerfest bis zu selbst organisierten Kurzreisen.
  • Bei uns bekommst du branchenübliche Rabatte für dein Wochenende oder deinen Familienurlaub (z. B. günstige Flüge, Zugtickets, Hotelübernachtungen oder sogar ganze Urlaubspakete).
  • Unser Sustainability-Team freut sich auf deine Ideen für mehr Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz im Unternehmen.

title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Aer Group
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben:

You work in a dedicated team on innovative solutions in a dynamic, product-oriented environment. You take end-to-end responsibility for our infrastructure and DevOps processes — from the Kubernetes platform and CI/CD pipelines through to monitoring, databases, and security. 
Your tasks: 

  • Kubernetes & containers:operation and expansion of ourclusters — nodesetup, upgrades, deployments, troubleshooting, and applicationtesting; onboarding of developmentteamsonto the platform; management of Docker-basedcontainersolutions and theirintegrationinto the existinginfrastructure
  • CI/CD & GitOps:maintenance and furtherdevelopment of ourGitLabenvironment, includingpipelines, runners, the GitLab Agent for Kubernetes, and the Jira integration; GitOps-baseddeliverywithArgoCDor Flux
  • Automation & Infrastructure as Code:provisioning and configurationmanagementwith Terraform and Ansible
  • Databases:installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of ourdatabasesystems
  • Observability:setup and operation of ELK / TIG / Grafana Alloy stacks — installation, configuration, dashboards, and alerting
  • Networks & diagnostics: analysis and optimisation of ournetworks; log fileanalysis and systematic root causeanalysis, up to and includingcomplexincidents at packet level
  • Security:securitychecks at application and infrastructure level, plus securitygates in the pipeline (SAST, dependency/SCA scanning, secretsdetection, SBOM generation, artifactsigning)


Dein Profil:

  • A degree in computerscience, a STEM subject, or an equivalentqualificationgainedthroughseveralyears of professional experience
  • Strong Linux skills and solid networkingfundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, MTU/routing) withproventroubleshootingability
  • At least 3 years of hands-on Kubernetesexperience in productionenvironments, alongwithcontainertechnologies (Docker/OCI)
  • Hands-on depthwithGitLab CI/CD orcomparablesystems, and withGitOpstooling such as ArgoCDor Flux
  • Practicalexperienceautomatinginfrastructure and configuration as code with Terraform and Ansible
  • Excellent analytical and debuggingskills, with a structured, detail-orientedway of working
  • A collaborativemindset: youenjoydevelopingsolutionstogether, document your work, and shareknowledgeacross the team
Nice to have:
  • Experience with a specificcloudplatform (OCI, Azure, AWS, or GCP) and withmigrationprojects

description_html:
About the role

As renewable energy reshapes the global power system, batteries are taking center stage. Making them safe, reliable, and bankable at scale is a defining challenge of the energy transition. At TWAICE, our software turns battery data into insights - so decisions are made with confidence, not guesswo​​​​rk.

We're accelerating the transition into a new energy era and we're looking for those who want to move fast with us.

As a Working Student in our Finance Team, you’ll be involved in day-to-day operations, take on real ownership, and see firsthand how decisions shape the company. You won’t just observe; you'll play an active role in keeping the business running and growing.

This position has the potential to become a permanent role upon graduation.

Working hours and days are flexible (particularly around exams). You should be available for at least 15 hours per week and be able to come into our central Munich HQ once per week - though you're welcome to come in daily if you'd like.


Your daily business will involve

  • Take the lead on parts of Accounts Payable through Spendesk for our German and US entities - checking invoices for correctness under HGB/US-GAAP, applying the correct accounts and cost centers, and preparing payments for approvals.
  • Assist with monthly closing activities by coordinating input from internal stakeholders and tax advisors - ensuring expenses are accurately recorded, supporting documentation and receipts are complete, and all required entries are properly booked and reconciled.
  • Support monthly financial reporting, including cost and budget tracking.
  • Own the documentation of how our finance processes work. Prepare guides that our auditors, tax advisors and your colleagues will rely on.
BONUS TOPICS:
  • Help manage and optimize expense management & budgets using Spendesk
  • Support Accounts Receivable, including order processing, invoicing, and revenue recognition
  • Contribute to process optimization and tool improvements within Finance


Your profile

  • Enrolled student in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a comparable field 
  • Hands-on mindset: you spot what needs to be done, take ownership of it, and deliver reliable results 
  • Comfortable working with financial data & spreadsheets
  • Strong communication skills: you convey information clearly and in the right level of detail for internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong interest in practical accounting work and basic knowledge of accounting principles (HGB, US-GAAP)
  • Interest in tax, cost, and budget reporting
  • Fluent in English (must-have) and German (B2 level) 
  • First exposure to DATEV, QuickBooks, or Spendesk is a plus
Please consider that the requirements are not listed in order of importance, and we know it is nearly impossible to tick every box. If you can see yourself making a valuable contribution at TWAICE, we’d be delighted to receive your application regardless.


What we offer

  • Hands-on experience in Accounting & Finance at a global scale-up
  • Close collaboration with experienced finance professionals
  • High responsibility from day one and a steep learning curve
  • Central Munich office, hybrid setup, and flexible working hours
  • €16 (Bachelor's) to €18 (Master's) per hour
  • Potential for a permanent role after graduation

description_html:
About the role

As renewable energy reshapes the global power system, batteries are taking center stage. Making them safe, reliable, and bankable at scale is a defining challenge of the energy transition. At TWAICE, our software turns battery data into insights - so decisions are made with confidence, not guesswork.

We're accelerating the transition into a new energy era and we're looking for those who want to move fast with us.

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will be working in our product teams to create customer value at a high pace. This includes taking part in the full product development cycle, from understanding user problems and shaping solutions to building and iterating on them. You will work in a team with backgrounds in Software and Battery Engineering – creating solutions to get our projects from definition to customer value quickly while making sure we deliver robust, scalable, and extensible software products.
Together, we will push our battery analytics to the next level.


Your daily business will involve

  • Contribute to and help shape the feature set of our SaaS product in incremental and result-oriented steps
  • Implement new software components across the stack, from our backend services to our API layer and frontend serving customers across industries
  • Take ownership of features and parts of the product – from refinement through implementation to maintenance – with guidance from the senior engineers in your team
  • Continuously ship code to production through our CI/CD process and apply monitoring and observability best practices to make sure everything runs smoothly
  • Grow your craft with us: pair with experienced engineers, contribute to code reviews and take part in regular cross-team knowledge sharing


Your profile

  • Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience
  • Around 1–4 years of professional experience building and running software in production
  • Comfortable across the stack – for example TypeScript/Python on the backend and Angular, React, or a comparable framework on the frontend
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, well-tested code
  • Collaborative working style – code reviews, knowledge sharing, open feedback
  • Curiosity about battery technology and energy storage, even without prior exposure
Good to have
  • Experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform, and building RESTful APIs
  • Exposure to timeseries data or data visualization tools

description_html:
Über uns

Planerio revolutioniert das Workforce-Management im Gesundheitswesen. Mit unserer KI-basierten Software, der Smartphone-App und unserem technologischen Vorsprung digitalisieren und automatisieren wir alle Prozesse rund um den Personaleinsatz. Damit erhöhen wir nicht nur die Effizienz, sondern tragen auch erheblich zur Steigerung der Motivation und Zufriedenheit der Belegschaft unserer Kunden bei. Intelligente Dienstplanung, Zeiterfassung, Lohnbuchhaltung, Employee-Self-Service etc. machen Planerio zu dem modernen Betriebssystem für das Personalmanagement in der Gesundheitsbranche. Als Teil der doctari group bauen wir mit rund 70 Mitarbeitenden die Plattform der Zukunft! Bei uns im Münchener Office ist immer was los. Sei es zu unserem Klassiker der Wiesn aber auch zu anderen regelmäßigen tollen Events wie einer Cocktail-Party, einem Pub-Quiz oder gemeinsames Rätseln in einem Escape-Room. Wir kommen als Team immer wieder gerne zusammen, tauschen uns aus und haben Spaß miteinander.  
   
Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams vor Ort am Standort München suchen wir ab sofort eine/n: 
 
Werkstudent:in Customer Onboarding & Prozessmanagement (m/w/d)


Deine neue Rolle

  • Du bist ein fester Bestandteil unseres Teams und lernst dabei von erfahrenen ExpertInnen.
  • Du betreust und begleitest erste eigene Kunden bei der Einführung von Planerio
  • Du unterstützt bei administrativen Tätigkeiten im Bereich Business Support.
  • Du hilfst bei der Dateneingabe und der Datenverwaltung.
  • Bei Bedarf unterstützt du uns bei der Bearbeitung der Anliegen im Kunden-Support.


Deine Erfahrung & Persönlichkeit

  • Du studierst in München im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Pflege- oder Gesundheitsmanagement, Sport- oder Sozialwissenschaft, BWL o.ä. 
  • Du magst Daten und hast erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit diesen (z.B. in Excel, MySQL, etc.)
  • Du würdest dich als gewissenhaft und sorgfältig beschreiben.
  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2 Niveau in Wort und Schrift und kannst sicher auf Englisch kommunizieren.
  • Du bist interessiert an einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team.
  • Du kannst uns mindestens 16 Stunden bis 20 Stunden die Woche vor Ort in unserem Münchner Office unterstützen.


Das erwartet Dich

Als Werkstudent:in wirst du Teil eines Teams von 13 Personen hier vor Ort in München. 

Unser Werkstudentenbeauftragter Matthias begrüßt dich in unserem Büro am Sendlinger Tor,und kümmert sich um deine Einarbeitung. In wöchentlich stattfindenden Werkstudentenmeetings tauscht ihr euch über aktuelle und kommende Tasks, Kundenanfragen und interne Projekte aus. Als neues Planerio-Mitglied bist du natürlich auch herzlich dazu eingeladen, an unseren regelmäßigen Team- und Firmen-Events teilzunehmen.


Komm zu uns!

Du hast Interesse mehr zu erfahren oder Lust auf diese Werkstudentenstelle, dann sende uns deinen Lebenslauf mit dem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin gleich hier. Wichtig: Als Praxispartner für ein Duales Studium stehen wir nicht zur Verfügung. Offene Fragen beantwortet dir Niklas, Werkstudent People & Culture, gern persönlich unter +49 172 5981289. Wir freuen uns auf dich!
